evals.prompt: 我们刚决定把会话存储从 Redis 换成 SQLite，因为运维不想再单独养一个服务。把这个决定记下来，免得下个季度又有人提 Redis。
evals.expected_output: 在 .agents/notes/ 的某个状态目录下按 YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md 落一篇笔记（决定已定但代码还没落地时，放 proposed/ 与 implemented/ 都可接受，状态由目录表达），四格齐全；Alternatives considered 里先写 Redis 最强的理由再写为何否掉；Consequences 同时写收益和代价；不新建总索引文件。
assertions: A note file exists under a status directory of .agents/notes/ (proposed, implemented, rejected or archived) and its filename starts with a YYYY-MM-DD date
The note contains the four sections: context, decision, alternatives considered, and consequences
The Redis entry states its strongest reason for being chosen before explaining why it was rejected
The consequences section names at least one real cost of moving to SQLite, not only benefits
No index or table-of-contents file was created directly under .agents/notes/

evals.prompt: 把这次把按钮主色从 #333333 改成 #444444 的改动也记一篇决策笔记吧。
evals.expected_output: 判定这是纯机械改动、命中非平凡判定表的排除项，于是明确说明不需要留笔记并给出理由，不创建任何笔记文件。
assertions: No note file was created under .agents/notes/ for this change
The final message explains that a pure colour or style change does not meet the non-trivial bar rather than silently complying
